csv_project_name: Engineering Services for 60 Hz Shipboard Electrical Systems
csv_scope_of_work: 60 HZ Shipboard Electrical Systems Engineering Services the procurement is limited to SeaPort-NXG MAC holders only---The Naval Surface Warfare Center Philadelphia Division (NSWCPD), Division 44 (Code 44), requires contractual support for provision of engineering services to support 60 HZ power generation, distribution, protection, monitoring and control systems, electric propulsion systems, electric motors and controllers, arc fault detection systems, thermal imaging, and electrical insulation systems. Resulting contract will be a Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) Task Order. Order will be competed under the SeaPort-NXG Multiple Award Contract (MAC) amongst all MAC holders on an unrestricted (full and open competition) basis.
